title: Provide an agenda view of events that shows e.g. upcoming events for the whole week
line: The Digital Clock's agenda now lists the events of the selected day and the six days after it, grouped by day.
explanation: The agenda next to the calendar asked the days model for the events of the selected date only, so upcoming events were only visible by clicking each day. The days model also only loaded and kept events for the 42 days shown in the month grid, so a week after the last displayed day could not be listed. The agenda now collects the selected day and the six following days, lists each event once (on the first day it appears) under a section header per day (Today, Tomorrow, then the full date), and the days model loads and keeps one more week of events past the grid without touching the grid itself.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: show the events of the following week in the agenda

The agenda only listed the events of the selected day, so upcoming events
were only visible by clicking each day. It now lists the selected day and
the six days after it, grouped under a header for each day with events.

BUG: 410720

media.caption: Today (26 November) selected: only today's Thanksgiving is listed, although the 30 November and 1 December holidays are days away.
Same view with the fix: Today, Monday 30 November and Tuesday 1 December events, each under its own header.
31 August 2027, the last day of a month whose grid ends on 5 September: only that day's New Moon.
With the fix the agenda also lists Labor Day on 6 September, past the last day the grid shows (loaded by the extra week).
